title: October Horror Movie Catalog
metadataNotes: Intensity is subjective and independent of critical reception. Lighter films may still contain gore.
Production countries use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. An empty array means unverified, not United States.
culturalFocus is an editorial description, not exhaustive production-country metadata.
versionLabel disambiguates the supplied title; it does not constitute verification of production countries.
References marked search lead to search results, not verified movie pages.
Critic percentages are dated positive-review shares, not live scores or average ratings.
Reception is unreviewed where no current research snapshot was recorded; this does not indicate poor quality.
Original festival-release years can differ from U.S. release years on reference sites.
Blurbs, genre tags, languages, and runtimes are omitted because they were not systematically supplied or verified.
